buildSteps:
printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/filex-mcp.XXXXXX)' 'mkdir -p "$D/data" "$D/files"' 'P=$(od -An -N24 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d " 
")' 'FILEX_DATA_DIR="$D/data" FILEX_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:5212 FILEX_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com FILEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD="$P" FILEX_DEFAULT_STORAGE_DRIVER=local FILEX_DEFAULT_STORAGE_NAME=files FILEX_DEFAULT_STORAGE_PATH="$D/files" FILEX_UPDATE_CHECK=0 FILEX_APP_PLUGIN_UPDATE_CHECK=0 FILEX_THUMBS_ENABLED=false filex serve >"$D/filex.log" 2>&1 &' 'i=0' 'until curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:5212/healthz 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ "$i" -gt 240 ]; then cat "$D/filex.log" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.25; done' 'curl -fsS -o /dev/null -c "$D/jar" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"$P"}" http://127.0.0.1:5212/api/auth/login' 'T=$(curl -fsS -b "$D/jar" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{"label":"glama","scopes":"read,write,delete,comments:rw,mcp"}" http://127.0.0.1:5212/api/admin/ai-tokens | node -pe "JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).token")' 'umask 077' 'printf "Authorization: Bearer %s
" "$T" > "$D/headers"' 'rm -f "$D/jar"' 'unset P T' 'exec mcp-remote http://127.0.0.1:5212/api/ai/mcp --header-file "$D/headers" --transport http-only --allow-http --silent' > /usr/local/bin/filex-mcp-stdio && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/filex-mcp-stdio
